Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXX OF 2002
SINDH CIVIL COURTS
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XXX OF 2002
An Ordinance to amend the Sindh Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 18th September, 2002]
No.S.Legis.1(30)/2002, dated
18-9-2002.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby
published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.----(1) This Ordinance may be called the Sindh Civil Courts
(Amendment) Ordinance; 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Substitution of section 7 of W.P. Ordinance No.II of 1962

ORDINANCE XXX OF 2002
SINDH CIVIL COURTS
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XXX OF 2002
An Ordinance to amend the Sindh Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 18th September, 2002]
No.S.Legis.1(30)/2002, dated
18-9-2002.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby
published for general information:--
2. Substitution of section 7
of W.P. Ordinance No.II of 1962.----In the Sindh Civil Courts Ordinance,
1962, hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance, for section 7, the
following shall be substituted:--
"7.
Original Jurisdiction of the Court of District Judge.--Subject to this
Ordinance or any law for the time being in force, the original jurisdiction of
the Court of the District Judge in civil suits and proceedings shell be without
limit of the value thereof excepting in the Karachi Districts where the
original jurisdiction in civil suits and proceedings of the value exceeding
thirty lacs of rupees shall be exercised by the High Court."

Amendment of section 18 of W.P. Ordinance No.II of 1962

published for general information:--
3. Amendment of section 18 of
W.P. Ordinance No.II of 1962.--In the said Ordinance in section 18 for
subsection (1), the following shall be substituted.--
"(1) Save
as aforesaid, an appeal from a decree or order of a Civil Judge shall lie to
the District Judge."

4. Amendment of section 24 of
W.P. Ordinance No.II of 1962.--In the said Ordinance, in section 24, for
the words "five lacs of rupees" wherever occurring, the words
"thirty lacs of rupees" shall be substituted.

Transfer of matters

5. Transfer of matters.--All
suits, appeals and proceedings of the value not exceeding the original or
appellate pecuniary jurisdiction of the District Judge at and outside Karachi
respectively pending in the High Court immediately before the commencement of
this Ordinance shall stand transferred to the concerned District Judge for
disposal.
